subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should this protected PR be closed as superseded by the current-main Anthropic Vertex SDK 0.19 dependency update, or should maintainers sponsor a refreshed local Vertex client replacement?
rationale: The central audit/auth dependency issue appears covered on main, but the PR has protected labels and a local auth-provider replacement that requires maintainer intent rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Treat the merged dependency update as the maintained fix path and close this stale local-client branch after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Refresh A Narrow SDK-Based Fix
options.body: If more proof is needed, refresh on current main without replacing the official SDK path and add only the missing validation.

options.title: Sponsor Local Client
options.body: Keep the local BaseAnthropic/GoogleAuth direction only with explicit auth-provider acceptance, package metadata repair, and live Vertex ADC proof.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Treat the merged dependency update as the maintained fix path and close this stale local-client branch after maintainer confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored this PR and the merged dependency update that now covers the central dependency graph.
